blockers.title: The new platform validator collapses D-002's four OS/architecture targets to two OS tokens
locations: docs/coop/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md D-002 Platforms and D-007 matrix-shape clauses
blockers.counterexample: For component B, record validatedPlatformSets={macOS, linux}, exactly the two tokens v9 says form the current D-002 vocabulary. Build fixtureDomainBasis over those two values, execute one default architecture for each OS, hash the resulting basis, and reconcile every executed FDB cell exactly under G16-14. The run has no macOS-x86_64 or Linux-arm64 cell and can still pass every v9 platform-domain rule because architecture is not represented anywhere in the subject.
blockers.measurement: The adopted D-002 source defines four preview platforms: macOS arm64, macOS x86_64, Linux x86_64, and Linux arm64. D-007 reinforces that the platform axis is 'D-002's four.' V9 instead defines the vocabulary parenthetically as 'currently linux, macOS' and contains zero occurrences of arm64 or x86_64. effectivePlatformAxis and the FDB product therefore preserve at most two OS-family values, not the four adopted platform identities.
blockers.risk: A self-consistent ownership digest, FDB digest, and exact G16-14 reconciliation can qualify without closure evidence for two adopted platform targets. That is an affected-platform omission under DR-G16's no-waiver rule, not merely a naming preference.
blockers.suggestedFix: Define a platform identity as the exact D-002 OS/architecture tuple and validate against the four-value set {macOS-arm64, macOS-x86_64, Linux-x86_64, Linux-arm64}, using canonical spellings that match the manifest contract. Make effectivePlatformAxis and G16-10 range over those identities; keep Windows as the separately deferred slot.

shouldFix.title: ROLELESS-NA is selector-valid but still has no qualification disposition against the component lane's unconditional language gates
shouldFix.counterexample: B carries a valid ROLELESS-NA declaration. V9 correctly gives B nonempty FDB cells and does not REFUSE it. When B's lane is selected, componentLane.must still unconditionally requires language-native capability/parity, behavior, performance, runtime-UX, packaging-adapter, and conformance gates. B has no applicable language role. Marking the ROLELESS-NA result PASS/N-A silently waives that unconditional requirement; marking it NON-PASS makes the newly lawful state unable to qualify. No clause chooses between those outcomes.
shouldFix.measurement: ROLELESS-NA is now called lawful, complete, non-missing, and a named cell value, which fixes the empty-factor and dead-refusal defects. Unlike DEF-WIN, however, no ROLELESS-NA occurrence says slot-complete, qualification-neutral, PASS, NON-PASS, deferred, or which componentLane.must obligations are inapplicable. The frozen CLAUDE-V8-S1 repair explicitly requested a disposition as well as a cell value and classifier exemption; v9 implements the latter two only.
shouldFix.risk: Implementations can disagree between an implicit language-gate waiver and permanent fail-closed qualification for the same valid sentinel state. The selector remains safe, so this is SHOULD-FIX rather than a second blocker.
shouldFix.suggestedFix: Define ROLELESS-NA's result disposition explicitly and condition the language-native subset of componentLane.must on a real applicable role, while preserving generic build/test/package/sign/attest/SBOM obligations. If roleless components are not lawful preview identities, remove ROLELESS-NA instead.

verdictBasis: 1 blocker, 2 SHOULD-FIX findings, and 1 advisory. ACCEPT requires 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX; the gate is not met.
verdictStatement: REJECT. V9's newly custodied platform validator defines the current D-002 vocabulary as only linux and macOS, while adopted D-002 and D-007 require four OS/architecture platform identities. A self-consistent two-OS fixture domain can therefore omit macOS-x86_64 and Linux-arm64 and still satisfy the authored reconciliation. The operative recorded-input locators also remain stale at V8, and lawful ROLELESS-NA cells still lack an explicit disposition against unconditional language gates.

authorityOfThisVerdict.note: Independent review only. DR-121 remains OPEN, G16 remains not QUALIFIED, and coordinator disposition is separate.
